subject.title: [Feature] Control UI: Support channel-based session view toggle

question: Should OpenClaw stop at the current Sessions page Group by channel behavior, or add a first-class separated/merged channel timeline toggle?
rationale: Current main covers channel grouping, but the requested merged timeline and separated tab mode require UX, privacy, and Gateway/session semantics that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Scope The Toggle Semantics
options.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical channel-view thread and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

options.title: Treat Grouping As Sufficient
options.body: Close the remaining request if maintainers decide Group by channel plus per-session navigation is the intended Control UI surface.

options.title: Fold Into Sessions Workspace
options.body: Move the remaining work under https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one broader sessions workspace design to own channel views too.

recommendation.title: Scope The Toggle Semantics
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the canonical channel-view thread and define separated view, merged timeline, routing, and privacy semantics before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the closest current implementation and recent docs update for Control UI session grouping.
